headline: Sensex and Nifty Surge to Record Highs as FMCG and Banking Sectors Lead Broad Market Rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong Q2 earnings performance from companies like Emcure Pharma boosted investor confidence.
A broad-based rally in FMCG, Auto, and Private Banking sectors drove the indices higher.
Positive momentum continued for the fourth consecutive day, pushing the Sensex to a record intraday high.
Anticipation of strong Q2 results for MCX led to a significant jump in its share price.
whatHappening: The Sensex surged 1,225 points to close at 23,811, while the Nifty 50 rallied over 1.6% to end above 23,800.
Emcure Pharma shares jumped 7% after reporting a 29% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 325 crore.
Choice International announced a 1:1 bonus issue to reward its shareholders.
Zydus Wellness reported a net profit of ₹5.1 crore for the second quarter with revenue rising to ₹1,126 crore.
summary: The Indian stock market witnessed a massive rally with the Sensex jumping 1,225 points and Nifty closing above 23,800. Gains were led by the FMCG and banking sectors, alongside strong individual performances from Emcure Pharma and MCX. Investors remained optimistic despite global risks and upcoming US midterm elections.
